activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1863 as Verne's representative French literary breakthrough year, when Five Weeks in a Balloon received its first Paris edition and launched the career associated with the Voyages extraordinaires.

sources.title: Cinq semaines en ballon — Bibliothèque nationale de France
sources.citation_text: The Bibliothèque nationale de France catalogue dates Five Weeks in a Balloon to 1863 and records its first edition in Paris on 31 January 1863.
